messages.content: তোমার সাথে একটা serious কথা বলতে চাই।
ami amar current job e stuck feel korchi, kintu switch korার moto courage nai
Stuck feeling ta ki job er nature niye, naki growth na thakার niye? Duita solve kora different way te hoy।
mostly growth na thakar niye, kintu ekta secure salary chere jete bhoy lagche
Sheta valid bhoy, secure income chara decision neya sohoj na। Kintu ekta option ache - notun kichur jonno prepare kora shuru koro current job e thakte thakte, tarpor jump dao jokhon ready.
